result.brief: 提出以视频世界模型为统一视觉想象引擎的智能体框架，通过工具与技能编排多种视觉操作，并联合演化VLM与世界模型执行代码以提升时空与因果推理。
result.reason: Uses video world model as unified visual imagination engine for agentic spatiotemporal reasoning; contributes harness/tool orchestration over VWM rather than new representation, but directly concerns VWM use.
